name: Distracted Boyfriend
meaning: Being tempted by something new while ignoring an existing commitment.
description: A guy turns to look at another girl walking past while his girlfriend looks at him in disbelief.
situations: abandoning a commitment for something new

name: This Is Fine
meaning: Pretending everything is okay while a situation falls apart.
description: A cartoon dog sits calmly with a drink in a room surrounded by flames.

name: Drake Hotline Bling
meaning: Rejecting one option and enthusiastically approving another.
description: Two panels show Drake turning away from one option and smiling while pointing at the other.
situations: rejecting an option and approving another

name: Two Buttons
meaning: Struggling to choose between two difficult or contradictory options.
description: A cartoon man sweats as he tries to decide which of two red buttons to press.

name: Woman Yelling at a Cat
meaning: An angry accusation paired with a confused or unimpressed response.
description: A woman points and shouts beside an image of a white cat sitting at a dinner table.
situations: responding to an accusation with confusion

name: Expanding Brain
meaning: A progression of ideas presented as increasingly enlightened, often sarcastically.
description: A series of brains becomes larger and more brightly glowing with each successive panel.

name: Surprised Pikachu
meaning: Acting shocked by an obvious or predictable consequence.
description: Pikachu stares ahead with wide eyes and an open mouth in surprise.
situations: ignoring a warning and regretting it

name: Success Kid
meaning: Celebrating a small victory or a moment of good luck.
description: A small child on a beach clenches a fist with a determined expression.

name: UNO Draw 25
meaning: Choosing an excessive penalty rather than doing something unwanted.
description: A card offers an action or drawing 25 cards, followed by a player holding many cards.
situations: avoiding an easy but unwanted task

name: Change My Mind
meaning: Presenting a firmly held opinion as a challenge to others.
description: A man sits behind a table with a sign ending in Change My Mind.

name: Disaster Girl
meaning: Looking suspiciously pleased while chaos unfolds.
description: A young girl looks back at the camera with a slight smile while a house burns behind her.

name: Hide the Pain Harold
meaning: Masking discomfort or sadness with an unconvincing smile.
description: An older gray-haired man smiles stiffly, often pictured holding a mug near a laptop.

name: Gru's Plan
meaning: Realizing that a carefully explained plan contains an unwanted consequence.
description: Gru presents a sequence of steps on a board and then looks back at the unexpected final step.
situations: discovering a flaw in your own strategy

name: Is This a Pigeon?
meaning: Confidently mistaking something for a completely different thing.
description: An anime character gestures toward a butterfly while asking whether it is a pigeon.

name: Mocking SpongeBob
meaning: Repeating another person's words in a sarcastic or mocking tone.
description: SpongeBob bends forward with a birdlike posture and a distorted expression.

name: Boardroom Meeting Suggestion
meaning: Punishing the person who suggests a sensible answer in a dysfunctional group.
description: Workers offer ideas at a meeting; the boss throws the final speaker out a window.

name: Running Away Balloon
meaning: Being held back from something desirable by an obligation or obstacle.
description: A simple comic character reaches for a floating balloon while another figure restrains them.

name: Left Exit 12 Off Ramp
meaning: Suddenly abandoning a sensible path for a tempting alternative.
description: A car swerves sharply toward a highway exit beneath a directional sign.

name: One Does Not Simply
meaning: Pointing out that an apparently simple task is actually difficult.
description: Boromir raises a hand while explaining a difficult undertaking.
situations: warning that a shortcut will not work

name: Ancient Aliens
meaning: Offering an absurdly convenient explanation without convincing evidence.
description: A television presenter with swept-up hair gestures with both hands.
situations: explaining a mystery with wild speculation

name: Waiting Skeleton
meaning: Waiting so long that the wait feels endless.
description: A skeleton sits on a bench as though it has waited there indefinitely.

name: Bad Luck Brian
meaning: Experiencing an absurdly unlucky outcome even when trying to succeed.
description: A red-haired boy wearing braces and a sweater vest smiles in a school portrait.

name: First World Problems
meaning: Dramatizing a minor inconvenience from a position of comfort.
description: A woman presses her hand against her face while appearing to cry.
situations: being upset over a luxury problem

name: Roll Safe
meaning: Presenting flawed logic as if it were a clever solution.
description: A smiling man points a finger at his temple.

name: Confused Nick Young
meaning: Reacting with disbelief to something that makes little sense.
description: Nick Young tilts his head with a puzzled smile, surrounded by question marks.
situations: not understanding what someone just said

name: Leonardo DiCaprio Laughing
meaning: Reacting with smug amusement or delight at an ironic situation.
description: Leonardo DiCaprio as Calvin Candie laughs while holding a small glass.
situations: feeling smug about someone else's mistake

name: Always Has Been
meaning: Discovering a hidden truth that another person already knew.
description: An astronaut looks toward Earth while a second astronaut behind them points a gun.
situations: realizing something was true all along

name: Trade Offer
meaning: Framing an exchange as a deal, often with obviously unequal benefits.
description: A suited man holds his fingertips together beneath a trade offer heading.

name: Bernie I Am Once Again Asking
meaning: Repeating a request for help, support, or a long-overdue action.
description: Bernie Sanders stands outdoors wearing a winter coat while addressing the camera.
aliases: I Am Once Again Asking for Your Financial Support

name: Batman Slapping Robin
meaning: Abruptly interrupting or correcting another person's statement.
description: A comic panel shows Batman slapping Robin as they speak.

name: Monkey Puppet
meaning: Looking away awkwardly to avoid admitting involvement or embarrassment.
description: A monkey puppet glances sideways and then faces forward.
situations: avoiding eye contact after an awkward remark

name: They're The Same Picture
meaning: Claiming that two supposedly different things are effectively identical.
description: An office comparison asks for differences between two pictures; Pam says they are the same.
aliases: Corporate Needs You to Find the Difference
situations: comparing things with no meaningful difference

name: Bike Fall
meaning: Causing one's own problem and blaming someone else.
description: A cyclist puts a stick into the front wheel, crashes, and complains.
situations: blaming others for a self-inflicted problem

name: Clown Applying Makeup
meaning: Showing a progression of increasingly foolish beliefs or decisions.
description: Successive panels show a person applying clown makeup and completing the costume.
situations: doubling down on a bad argument
realizing how foolish you have been

name: Panik Kalm Panik
meaning: Moving from panic to brief reassurance and back to panic.
description: Three illustrated panels alternate between an alarmed face, a calm face, and renewed alarm.
situations: finding temporary reassurance before worse news

name: Epic Handshake
meaning: Finding common ground between otherwise different groups.
description: A close-up shows two muscular arms clasping hands.
aliases: Dillon You Son of a Bitch
situations: opposing groups agreeing on one thing

name: Anakin Padme
meaning: An optimistic assumption gives way to concern when reassurance never comes.
description: Anakin and Padme talk in a meadow as Padme's smile turns concerned.
situations: assuming a change will be good
waiting for reassurance after a worrying statement

name: Evil Kermit
meaning: An internal debate between sensible behavior and a tempting bad impulse.
description: Kermit faces a hooded version of himself.
situations: arguing with your own bad impulses
talking yourself into a poor decision

name: Futurama Fry
meaning: Being unable to distinguish between two plausible explanations.
description: Fry narrows his eyes in a skeptical close-up.
situations: not sure whether something is intentional

name: Stonks
meaning: Celebrating a questionable financial decision with misplaced confidence.
description: A smooth computer-generated face stands before a market graphic labeled Stonks.
situations: calling a bad purchase an investment
